text:
lina_support: customer report — signed up, verified email, then swapped payment method; expected free trial credits but nothing added to account. account_id: acct_0a9b3c; region: IE; 3DS flow passed according to customer. billing-bot: attempted to attach payment method, gateway returned status `challenged` and `fraud_hold` in the webhook logs.
sara_support: thanks, lina. can you paste the payment method history and any gateway webhook ids? also has customer tried creating a brand-new account?
lina_support: paste from support form: `pm_history: [pm_visa_xxx -> removed (t+30s), pm_applepay_xxx -> attached (t+31s)]` webhook id: wh_01G9F2K. customer says they verified email at t+10s.
mike_ops: running quick query on payments table for acct_0a9b3c, one sec...
mike_ops: result snippet:
```
SELECT status, created_at, reason_code FROM payment_events WHERE acct='acct_0a9b3c' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;
-- rows:
-- challenged | 2024-11-03T14:12:31Z | BIN_COUNTRY_MISMATCH
-- attached  | 2024-11-03T14:12:30Z | SUCCESS
-- removed   | 2024-11-03T14:11:58Z | USER_REQUEST
```
aj_billing: looks like gateway flagged BIN_COUNTRY_MISMATCH after the card swap; that's why our promo gating didn't mark the account as eligible. system rule: if payment gate flags for cross-border BIN, we run manual review and withhold trial credits.
sara_support: customer notes they were physically in IE when signing up and both cards are EU-issued. can we check raw BIN?
mike_ops: raw bin for challenged card: 519020 -> resolves to PL in the provider database. customer-provided card was IE but swapped-in card is PL. That triggers our fraud heuristics for region-restricted promos.
lina_support: customer insists they live in IE and wants manual grant, has provided photo id via support ticket.
aj_billing: ok — escalate to manual grant. I'll need the support ticket link and confirmation of ID verification. Also confirm no prior abuse flags on acct_0a9b3c.
mike_ops: abuse history: clean. sending ticket link: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/34211. ID uploaded (passport).
aj_billing: initiating manual grant now. running `POST /internal/admin/grants` with payload:
```
{ "acct": "acct_0a9b3c", "grant_type": "free_trial", "amount": 25, "reason": "manual_grant_after_bin_mismatch_review", "approved_by": "aj_billing" }
```
billing-bot: grant processed — grant_id g_77b3e, amount 25 credited to acct_0a9b3c.
sara_support: replying to customer now that credits have been applied and explaining BIN mismatch cause. asked them to re-run their initial workflow and confirm. :white_check_mark:
lina_support: customer confirmed credits visible in dashboard and test generation succeeded. closing thread. :tada:
fraud-bot: note created in acct_0a9b3c -> reason: BIN_COUNTRY_MISMATCH (historical). flagged_by: gateway.
aj_billing: follow-up — we'll add a one-time exception for this promo and annotate account. filing short doc for case review in #billing-cases.
sara_support: thanks everyone, marking resolved.
